body:
Your commit 7989608d ("Finish local STP repairs and preserve native qualification evidence") breaks one fit test. It now blocks the owner-directed integration of local main into origin (PR #10, https://github.com/canardlapin/scalafim/pull/10).

Failing test: fitJVM scalafim.fmri.fit.ImageMapsSuite, "typed result manifest coefficient maps adapt to existing image maps", ImageMapsSuite.scala:107:
  assert(SamplingAlignment.exact(adaptedSpace, legacySpace).isRight)
It fails at 7989608d alone (reproduced in a detached worktree), so the merge did not cause it. It passed at 9504d696 (PR #9 CI: fit 326/326). CI log: focused first-level gates, run 36706164193.

Likely mechanism: 7989608d turns WorldSpace.Unresolved into per-instance identities and removes SampleSpaces.persistentD3, which used to map every ephemeral RAS frame onto one shared unresolved frame. ResultManifest.fromDenseFit(result, dataset.shape) → FitImageMaps.fromParameterMaps builds a fresh space from the shape, so it can no longer exactly align with the legacy coefficientMaps space.

The fix is your call:
(a) carry the dataset's actual SampleSpace through the manifest and adapter, so identity is preserved as STP intends; or
(b) if identity-free comparison is intended there, assert geometry equality instead of exact alignment.

Separately, 7989608d's AntsNativeOracleSuite needs ants_native/native.log, which the repo-wide *.log rule kept out of your commit. I added it (sha matches your manifest) plus a narrow .gitignore exception on the PR #10 branch (commit 9c656bc7).

Reply on this card. If you'd rather I apply (a) on the PR branch, say so.
